help: UNIQUE -- No more than 1 enhancement of this type may be slotted by a character. Gives a moderate chance to cause moderate smashing damage to your foe, and reduces the power's recharge time by {Boost.Attrib.Recharge.Scale}%.  This effect will trigger roughly 4.5 times per minute.
power_display_names: Superior Winter Storm: Recharge/Chance for Cold Damage
